text:
marcus: quick heads-up — after the runtime unpin at 02:00 we saw a small but persistent spike of model_bind_error (5xx). This is from the eu-west canary group. thinking we should put a safehold and consider re-pinning. details below :eyes:

deploybot: [automated] action=unpin_runtime runtime=v3.2 scope=eu-west user=marcus run_id=rb-4821 started=1823456700

anya: looking at logs now. saw KV cache mismatch in a subset of longseq requests. only ~0.6% of total but steady for 4m. canary instances show ↑latency too. recommend safehold (stop further unpins) and route canary traffic to fallback runtime v3.1 for now.

sri: agree with safehold. threshold proposal: if error rate > 1% or sustained for > 5m -> full rollback. otherwise isolated canary pin -> observe. also will open a pager if we hit 2% for 2m.

noah: SDK team here — small ABI change slipped through in v3.2 that changes plugin loader handshake. older SDK clients might fall back, new ones throw a binding error. we can hotfix SDK or pin runtime. hotfix ETA ~3h, pin/unpin is faster.

marcus: thanks. operations decision needed: re-pin canary only or global rollback. ops-jen can you lead the rollback if we go that route?

ops-jen: I can. my plan: 1) execute canary re-pin to v3.1 immediately 2) monitor 10m 3) if errors drop -> roll the same pin to prod in controlled window (change window open now until 04:30 UTC). I'll post /deploybot commands and a short status update.

sara: support notified. I'll draft a short internal blurb for SRE/CS and prepare a customer-facing note if we escalate. keep me posted on rollback timing.

anya: canary re-pin SGTM. sending the small pinlist snippet I'm going to apply to avoid touching other regions:

```
# pinlist override
runtime_pins:
  eu-west:
    runtime: v3.1  # revert for canary cohort only
```

ops-jen: executing now. /deploybot pin runtime v3.1 --scope=eu-west --cohort=canary --reason "model_bind_errors after unpin"

deploybot: [automated] action=pin_runtime runtime=v3.1 scope=eu-west cohort=canary user=ops-jen run_id=rb-4821 status=started ts=1823456901

ops-jen: pinned canary to v3.1, verifying. watching error rate and p99. will wait 6m before next step.

sri: metrics look promising so far — error rate down to 0.08% and p95 latency returning to baseline on canary.

noah: confirming SDK logs show the handshake errors disappear after the canary pin. looks like repro is fixed by reverting runtime.

marcus: good — plan to schedule prod pin for 1823457200 (in ~6m) unless any objections. we'll include release note blurb and link to postmortem ticket.

sara: +1, I'll attach customer note draft to the incident and flag support channels.

ops-jen: executing prod pin now (within change window). /deploybot pin runtime v3.1 --scope=prod --reason "rollback: model_bind_errors post-unpin" --ticket=INC-4821

deploybot: [automated] action=pin_runtime runtime=v3.1 scope=prod user=ops-jen run_id=rb-4821 status=completed ts=1823457090

marcus: rollback complete. leaving safehold on further unpins until SDK/ABI fix or a clear compatibility test is added to the preflight. assigning follow-ups: @noah SDK patch (INC-4821-1), @anya runtime test harness update (INC-4821-2), @sri postmortem (INC-4821-3).

anya: will add extra regression tests around plugin handshake and longseq paths.

sri: creating postmortem placeholder now. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

sara: support note posted. customer comms queued but on hold until we validate no broad impact.

marcus: closing thread — we'll keep the safehold until SDK patch lands and tests are green. thanks all.

deploybot: [automated] summary: run_id=rb-4821 actions=unpin(v3.2,eu-west)->pin(v3.1,eu-west canary)->pin(v3.1,prod) status=rolled-back duration=090s
